title: The Income-tax Act, 2025
verified_how: LDH IN/eGazette doc in.gazette.central.e.2025-08-21.265620 is the Gazette of India Extraordinary, Part II s.1, No. 35, 21 Aug 2025. It shows 'THE INCOME-TAX ACT, 2025 No. 30 OF 2025' and s.1(3): 'Save as otherwise provided in this Act, it shall come into force on the 1st April, 2026.' Today (22 Sep 2026) is after that date. The India Code handle for this Act was not found because the site blocks access.
notes: Replaces the Income-tax Act 1961 (Act 43 of 1961) from 1 Apr 2026, with savings for earlier assessment years. Salary TDS/withholding is in this Act. The URL is the Gazette mirror; replace it with the India Code handle when reachable.
